metric_spec.name: mean_exact_with_tolerance

output_schema.mean: finite JSON number; no additional fields

metric_spec.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the declared task set only when every task is scored
metric_spec.infrastructure_error: reward=null, verifier_error=1, process exit code 2; excluded from a publishable aggregate

runtime_profile.dependency_policy: Python standard library only in candidate and verifier; Harbor is supplied by the operator
runtime_profile.image_status: Tag is illustrative and not immutable; the operator must resolve and record actual image digests before an accepted run

oracle_policy.scope: Task-local independent arithmetic solution for fixture validation only
oracle_policy.candidate_access: Oracle files and reference.json are never copied into the candidate image
oracle_policy.sealed_test_policy: This example has no sealed tasks; real sealed answers and oracle artifacts stay private
